title: Support Full Keyboard Access when possible

statement.en: Support Full Keyboard Access when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はFull Keyboard Accessをsupportする。

conditions: Let people navigate and activate windows, menus, controls, and system features using only the keyboard.
Test with Full Keyboard Access enabled in the system accessibility settings.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Keyboards experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Respect standard keyboard shortcuts
